apps.localizedDescription: A cosy pixel-art idle game about running a hospital. Tap the medkit, heal patients, and grow a little clinic into a grand medical center.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Lucky Crate and Supply Packs have new prices: 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 and 21 Natal Gems
- Bottom background: pick any colour on a colour wheel (Settings), or keep Default Red
- Doctor Sorcerer picks up your circles much more easily

- Resting several fingers on the medkit no longer taps by itself
- Gem Shop items are sorted by the rebirth that unlocks them, then by price (Custom stays last)

- Resting several fingers on the medkit no longer keeps tapping by itself
- Buying a skin, tap effect or background no longer puts it on; press Use
- Background perks switch off as soon as you change background, and tell you when they're active
- Gloocose tells you what it paid every 200 bounces
- Rainy Window: a grey, gloomy day in light mode, and drops without trails
- Gem upgrades get steeper: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and 13 Natal Gems
- Two new Supply Packs: Giga and Supreme
- Lucky Crates can hold free supplies and whole Supply Packs
- The minigame win screen is tidier

- The Shop is now called Supplies
- Pick a bottom background in Settings; it shows behind the Hospital's heading too
- New Estonia and Cardboard medkit skins, and a Cardboard app icon
- Medkit skins unlock at new rebirths: Cardboard 1, Golden 2, Candy 4, Night Shift 6, Crystal 8, Holographic 10
- Gilded Bloom tap effect at rebirth 10
- Rainy Window background in Natal Gems
- Two new handy items: Tap Tonic (hold the medkit to tap) and Doctor Sorcerer (circle the medkit with two fingers)
- Trade Natal Gems for Care Coins at the bottom of Natal Gems
- New prices across the Store
- Taps are a little weaker
- Gloocose glides smoothly when the phone tilts
- Store rows line up, and background perks say clearly what they give
- Heart poster fixed, and several backgrounds refreshed

- 29 new supplies, from the Petri Dish to the Infinity Medkit
- A new Store with Care Coins and Natal Gems tabs, and a look you can change
- Spend Care Coins on new boosts, upgrades, handy items, medkit skins and backgrounds
- Backgrounds you buy now have secret perks
- India medkit skin, and the medkit icon now matches your skin
- Three new long balloon games: Sky Flight, Sky Sort and Sky Dose
- Sky Pop and Sky Signal are here, and Sky Drop and Sky Pop last longer
- A new Ultrasound Screen baby
- Bigger, easier-to-read text
- Supplies from the Stethoscope on cost a little more
- Ward wins pay fewer Care Coins
- Steady Hands is a little weaker

- Fixed the game freezing on iPhone right after opening
- The How to Play popup no longer flashes each time the game opens
- Gloocose now slides towards the low side when you tilt, and can reach the whole background

- New in the Gem Shop: Lucky Crates, with a good prize guaranteed by the tenth
- New in the Gem Shop: Supply Packs in three sizes, worth the same at any stage of the game
- 7 new achievements: every sticker, every skin, every upgrade, and buying certain boosts many times
- Long effect names scroll
- The hot air balloon no longer covers notifications
- The bandage arrow game needs a few fewer wraps
- On the web, the app button now works for any phone
